summary.text: Amber Baker is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 72 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former school principal, she holds a Ph.D. from Ohio State University and works as an educator and consultant.

paragraphs.text: Baker was born in Louisville, Kentucky, and earned a B.S. in elementary education from Winston-Salem State University and an M.A. and Ph.D. from Ohio State University.
Her career has included serving as principal of Kimberley Park School and as principal consultant with Beyond Expectations Consultants.
Baker assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Derwin Montgomery.
The General Assembly's website lists her occupation as educator and her county as Forsyth.
In the 2025-2026 session she is a member of the Election Law, Federal Relations and American Indian Affairs, Finance, Oversight, and Regulatory Reform committees, among others.
